method_notes: Google autocomplete (suggestqueries.google.com), DuckDuckGo/Bing/Amazon suggest endpoints and WebFetch of all competitor sites were BLOCKED by the egress proxy, so no raw autocomplete or on-page H1 scraping was possible. Keywords were harvested from ~50 WebSearch queries: competitor page titles/category names in results (these mirror what they target), result snippets, and topic phrasing recurring across multiple competitors, then expanded with standard Indian query modifiers (bulk, wholesale, price, under N, near me, for employees/clients, city names, Hinglish-free lowercase). est_popularity is a heuristic, not a volume: 'high' = head term appearing as a category/title on many major competitors (IGP, FNP, Giftana, Printstop, BoxUp etc.) or a known high-volume consumer query; 'medium' = seen on several competitor titles/snippets or an obvious commercial modifier of a head term; 'long-tail' = specific variants seen once or constructed from observed patterns. Validate with Google Keyword Planner / Search Console before committing budgets. product_match hints use the catalog's actual category and brand strings.
